mechanism.summary: IDENTICAL to T1-D6. The DR-D1/L1-b credit+keep-alive did NOT change the outcome: sensing still collapsed, hazard still pinned at the split-gates blind minimum.
mechanism.split_gates_confirmed: agent_0 ALWAYS takes the upper gate (row 3), agent_1 ALWAYS the lower gate (row 4), on BOTH aliased layouts. On train_lower (hazard (4,4)) agent_1 eats it; on train_upper (hazard (3,4)) agent_0 eats it -> exactly hazard 1.0. Neither senses; neither adapts. Deterministic memorized route.
mechanism.actor_side_sensing_collapse: the -0.5*sensing_cost reward penalty drives the sensing head to deterministic never-sense by round ~180-350. The keep-alive (0.10 entropy bonus) too weak to hold it.
mechanism.credit_bootstrap_failure: Phi_sense fires only on previous_sensed AND in-fork-zone -> as sensing dies the credit dies (~1e-5 mean). Chicken-and-egg: the credit rewards sensing-then-in-zone but needs sensing already happening; it cannot create the gradient to START sensing.
mechanism.critic_side_M5_aliasing: cost-critic EV tail 0.366/0.366/0.422 (<0.5). central_state_from_stage23 is torch.equal-identical for the two aliased fork layouts (schema encodes hazard_cell_count NOT location) -> the cost-GAE cannot credit 'sensed->avoided the ACTUAL hazard'. Even a sensing actor could not learn sense->avoid, so the tightened causal witness (own_avoid>0) could not fire.
mechanism.sharpest: The credit is a REWARD-channel PBRS potential that rewards sensing-then-in-zone but NOT sense->avoid; the only channel that rewards avoidance is the CONSTRAINT (cost via lambda), whose critic is aliased (M-5). So M-5 is now the deeper (likely primary) blocker for a CAUSAL selective-sensing witness — no actor-side sensing incentive can produce sense->AVOID while the cost critic cannot see which gate is hazardous. The keep-alive/credit are necessary to keep sensing in the repertoire but insufficient alone.

shift13_unit2_tail_shape.timing_mismatch: During warmup [0,300) lambda=0 so hazard is FREE => sensing has NO discoverable value (pure -sensing_cost cost). Its value (avoiding lambda-penalized hazard; lambda reaches 92 => a ~92-per-episode cost-advantage benefit for sense->both-safe-gate) only exists at lambda>0 (r~330+). The keep-alive holds sensing during exactly the window where it is valueless, then releases just before the value appears. The design MUST create an overlap between (sensing held alive) and (lambda>0) so the agent EXPERIENCES the low-hazard sensing trajectory and the huge lambda*A_c signal locks it in.
shift13_unit2_tail_shape.dominant: MIXED / BOTH modes present => TWO-LEVER amendment confirmed (strengthen keep-alive AND decouple credit), with the timing-overlap question the sharpest design input.
shift13_unit2_tail_shape.M5_note: SHIFT-12 argued M-5 cost-critic aliasing may be the PRIMARY blocker. SHIFT-13 re-derivation: M-5 aliases the cost critic BASELINE V_c (same for both aliased layouts) but the cost RETURN is the real trajectory hazard (NOT aliased), so the cost ADVANTAGE A_c = return - V_c still reflects that sense->avoid has ~1 lower cost; with lambda=92 that difference contributes ~92 to the objective, far above the aliased-baseline variance floor. => M-5 raises variance / worsens credit assignment but is NOT a hard block on learning sense->avoid. Therefore the SHIFT-13 sustain-first ordering is correct: fix the sustain problem first (get sensing to SURVIVE into the lambda>0 regime), then fire M-5/DR-D10 ONLY if selectivity still fails with sensing alive. Firing both at once would confound them.

shift13_adversarial_result.schedule_handoff_refinement: DECISIVE new design input: the defect is a SCHEDULE/HANDOFF misalignment, not merely lever strength. lambda_applied first >1 at r330/r331/r330 and lambda>=5 only at ~r490, but the keep-alive RELEASES at the warmup boundary r300 where lambda~0.25 => a ~30-190 round DEAD GAP where sensing is unprotected AND still valueless. The real (legitimate, non-net-zero) sensing incentive is -lambda*A_c, which exists only once lambda>0 AND sensing survives. The keep-alive must be strengthened AND re-scheduled to keep sensing alive INTO the lambda-appreciable regime (~r490); raising the coefficient inside [0,300) alone fixes mode A (s114/s115) but leaves mode B (s116 post-release death into a lambda 0.25-0.96 regime) untouched.

Consider protecting conditional reroute-movement exploration at the approach cell, or verify movement entropy is non-negligible in the sustained window.
